1	# Claude Hub
2	
3	Central management dashboard for all your Claude Code agents across every project.
4	
5	## What it does
6	
7	- **See all agents in one place** — global agents + every project's sub-agents
8	- **Create/edit/delete agents** — both global and per-project, from one UI
9	- **Edit CLAUDE.md files** — global and per-project, with save
10	- **Copy agents between projects** — or promote a project agent to global
11	- **View slash commands** — see and edit all /commands per project
12	- **Auto-discover projects** — scans your project folders automatically
13	
14	## Install
15	
16	```bash
17	# Clone or copy the claude-hub folder to anywhere on your Mac
18	cd claude-hub
19	npm install
20	npm start
21	```
22	
23	Open http://localhost:3847 in your browser.
24	
25	## First run
26	
27	1. Claude Hub asks you to add project directories (e.g. `~/projects`)
28	2. It scans those folders for any project with `.claude/` or `CLAUDE.md`
29	3. You see everything — all agents, all rules, all projects in one dashboard
30	
31	## How it works
32	
33	Claude Hub reads and writes the same files that Claude Code uses:
34	
35	```
36	~/.claude/CLAUDE.md          ← global rules (edit in Claude Hub)
37	~/.claude/agents/*.md        ← global agents (edit in Claude Hub)
38	~/projects/app1/CLAUDE.md    ← app rules (edit in Claude Hub)
39	~/projects/app1/.claude/agents/*.md  ← app sub-agents (edit in Claude Hub)
40	```
41	
42	When you edit in Claude Hub → the file changes on disk → Claude Code picks it up next session. Real-time sync.
43	
44	## Requirements
45	
46	- Node.js 18+
47	- macOS (or Linux/Windows)
48

196	  messages: AiMessage[],
197	  system: string | undefined,
198	  onChunk: (text: string) => void,
199	  signal?: AbortSignal,
200	): Promise<string> {
201	  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}/ai/stream`, {
202	    method: 'POST',
203	    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
204	    body: JSON.stringify({ messages, system }),
205	    signal,
206	  })
207	  if (!res.ok) {
208	    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: `HTTP ${res.status}` }))
209	    throw new Error(data.error || `API error: ${res.status}`)
210	  }
211	  const reader = res.body!.getReader()
212	  const decoder = new TextDecoder()
213	  let buffer = ''
214	  let fullContent = ''
215	
216	  while (true) {
217	    const { done, value } = await reader.read()
218	    if (done) break
219	    buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true })
220	    const parts = buffer.split('\n')
221	    buffer = parts.pop() ?? ''
222	    for (const line of parts) {
223	      const trimmed = line.trim()
224	      if (!trimmed.startsWith('data: ')) continue
225	      try {
226	        const event = JSON.parse(trimmed.slice(6))
227	        if (event.type === 'chunk') {
228	          fullContent += event.content
229	          onChunk(event.content)
230	        } else if (event.type === 'done') {
231	          fullContent = event.content
232	        } else if (event.type === 'error') {
233	          throw new Error(event.error)
234	        }
235	      } catch (e) {
236	        if (e instanceof SyntaxError) continue
237	        throw e
238	      }
239	    }
240	  }
241	  return fullContent
242	}

## Complete Claude Hub Feature Audit

Based on a thorough examination of the codebase, here's the complete inventory of Claude Hub:

---

## 1. API ENDPOINTS (47 total)

### Config & Project Management
- `GET /api/config` - Get configuration with Claude dir and project dirs
- `POST /api/config/project-dirs` - Update project directory paths
- `GET /api/projects` - List all discovered projects
- `GET /api/browse` - Directory browser (restricted to home directory)

### Global CLAUDE.md & Agents
- `GET /api/global/claude-md` - Get global CLAUDE.md content
- `PUT /api/global/claude-md` - Update global CLAUDE.md
- `GET /api/global/agents` - List all global agents
- `GET /api/global/agents/:name` - Get specific global agent
- `PUT /api/global/agents/:name` - Create/update global agent
- `DELETE /api/global/agents/:name` - Delete global agent

### Global Rules & Templates
- `GET /api/global/rules` - List global rules
- `GET /api/global/rules/:name` - Get specific global rule
- `PUT /api/global/rules/:name` - Create/update global rule
- `DELETE /api/global/rules/:name` - Delete global rule
- `GET /api/rule-templates` - List 20+ built-in rule templates
- `POST /api/global/rules/from-template` - Apply template to global rules
- `POST /api/init-rules` - Initialize rules across all projects from templates

### Global Settings
- `GET /api/global/settings` - Get global settings (stored as JSON)
- `PUT /api/global/settings` - Update global settings

### Project-Scoped Resources (Agents, Commands, Rules)
- `GET /api/projects/:id/claude-md` - Get project CLAUDE.md
- `PUT /api/projects/:id/claude-md` - Update project CLAUDE.md
- `GET /api/projects/:id/agents` - List project agents
- `GET /api/projects/:id/agents/:name` - Get specific project agent
- `PUT /api/projects/:id/agents/:name` - Create/update project agent
- `DELETE /api/projects/:id/agents/:name` - Delete project agent
- `GET /api/projects/:id/commands` - List project commands
- `GET /api/projects/:id/commands/:name` - Get specific command
- `PUT /api/projects/:id/commands/:name` - Create/update command
- `DELETE /api/projects/:id/commands/:name` - Delete command
- `GET /api/projects/:id/rules` - List project rules
- `GET /api/projects/:id/rules/:name` - Get specific project rule
- `PUT /api/projects/:id/rules/:name` - Create/update project rule
- `DELETE /api/projects/:id/rules/:name` - Delete project rule
- `POST /api/projects/:id/rules/from-template` - Apply template to project rules
- `POST /api/projects/:id/init-rules` - Initialize rules in project

### Agent Management
- `GET /api/unified/agents` - Get all agents (global + project) unified view
- `GET /api/categories` - List agent categories with counts
- `POST /api/copy-agent` - Copy agent between global and projects
- `POST /api/move-agent` - Move agent between global and projects

### AI Chat & Context
- `POST /api/ai/chat` - Send chat to Claude via stdin (non-streaming)
- `POST /api/ai/stream` - Send chat to Claude with SSE streaming
- `GET /api/ai/context` - Get full app context for AI (all agents, rules, CLAUDE.md)
- `POST /api/ai/apply` - Apply AI-suggested file writes (with path validation)

### AI Chat History
- `GET /api/ai/history` - List all chat sessions
- `GET /api/ai/history/:id` - Get specific chat session
- `POST /api/ai/history` - Save/update chat session
- `DELETE /api/ai/history/:id` - Delete chat session

### Training & Corrections
- `GET /api/training/:name` - Get training corrections for agent
- `POST /api/training/:name` - Add new training correction
- `PUT /api/training/:name/:id` - Update training correction
- `DELETE /api/training/:name/:id` - Delete training correction
- `POST /api/training/:name/bake` - Bake active corrections into agent (appends to body)

### Unified Views
- `GET /api/unified/commands` - All commands from all projects
- `GET /api/unified/rules` - All rules (global + project scoped)

### Output Templates
- `GET /api/templates` - List all output templates
- `GET /api/templates/:name` - Get specific template
- `PUT /api/templates/:name` - Create/update template
- `DELETE /api/templates/:name` - Delete template

### Agent Orchestration
- `GET /api/orchestrations` - List all orchestrations
- `POST /api/orchestrations` - Create/update orchestration
- `GET /api/orchestrations/:id` - Get specific orchestration
- `DELETE /api/orchestrations/:id` - Delete orchestration
- `POST /api/orchestrations/run` - Execute orchestration (SSE streaming)
- `GET /api/orchestrations/runs` - List run history
- `GET /api/orchestrations/runs/:id` - Get specific run details
- `DELETE /api/orchestrations/runs/:id` - Delete run from history
- `DELETE /api/orchestrations/runs` - Clear all run history

### Agent Playground
- `POST /api/playground/run` - Test any agent with a prompt (SSE streaming)

### Memory Brain
- `GET /api/memory` - Get memory directory tree structure
- `GET /api/memory/file` - Read specific memory file
- `PUT /api/memory/file` - Update memory file (with audit logging)
- `POST /api/memory/file` - Create new memory file
- `DELETE /api/memory/file` - Delete memory file
- `GET /api/memory/search` - Search across all memory files
- `GET /api/memory/stats` - Get memory statistics
- `POST /api/memory/folder` - Create folder in memory
- `DELETE /api/memory/folder` - Delete folder (must be empty)
- `POST /api/memory/move` - Rename/move memory file
- `GET /api/memory/history` - Get audit log with filtering/pagination
- `GET /api/memory/history/:id` - Get specific audit log entry
- `GET /api/memory/history/file/:filePath` - Get history for specific file
- `GET /api/memory/history-stats` - Statistics on memory changes
- `DELETE /api/memory/history` - Clear audit log

### Setup & Health
- `GET /api/setup/status` - PM2 status, LaunchAgent, agent count
- `GET /api/setup/projects` - Project discovery info
- `POST /api/setup/install-sdk` - Install SDK to projects
- `POST /api/setup/install-screenshot` - Take screenshots of pages
- `GET /api/health` - Server health/uptime

### Documentation
- `GET /api/docs` - List all documentation files
- `GET /api/docs/:slug` - Get specific documentation page

---

## 2. CLIENT-SIDE PAGES & UI FEATURES

### Core Management Pages
1. **Dashboard** - Overview with stats, agent teams by category, templates, service status
2. **All Agents** - Unified view of all agents (global + project) with search, filtering, categories
3. **All Commands** - Unified list of commands across all projects with search
4. **All Rules** - Unified view of rules (global + project) with scoping indicators

### Global Management
1. **Global CLAUDE.md** - Editor for ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md
2. **Agent Editor** (global) - Create/edit/delete global agents with markdown editor
3. **Rule Editor** (global) - Create/edit/delete global rules

### Project Management
1. **Project Detail** - View/edit project CLAUDE.md, agents, commands, rules
2. **Agent Editor** (project) - Create/edit/delete project-specific agents
3. **Command Editor** - Create/edit/delete project commands
4. **Rule Editor** (project) - Create/edit/delete project rules

### Advanced Features
1. **Orchestration** - Visual workflow builder with:
   - Drag-and-drop canvas
   - Node types: Start/Task, Agent Node, Custom Node
   - Edge connections
   - Real-time execution with SSE streaming
   - Run history with detailed logs

2. **Playground** - Test any agent with:
   - Agent selector
   - Prompt input
   - Real-time streaming output
   - Output templates injection

3. **Memory Brain** - Knowledge management with:
   - Tree view of ~/,.claude/memory/
   - File/folder creation, editing, deletion
   - Full-text search across memory
   - Folder organization
   - File metadata parsing (frontmatter)
   - Memory statistics (file count, size, type distribution)

## 3. DATA STORAGE

### File-Based Storage Locations

#### Global (~/.claude/)
- `CLAUDE.md` - Global system instructions
- `agents/*.md` - Global agents (frontmatter + markdown body)
- `rules/*.md` - Global rules
- `memory/` - Memory brain tree (organized folders)
- `settings.json` - Global settings
- Training data: `training/<agent-name>.json` & `.archived.json`

#### Project-Scoped (./<project>/.claude/)
- `agents/*.md` - Project agents
- `commands/*.md` - Project commands
- `rules/*.md` - Project rules

#### Claude Hub Config (in claude-hub root)
- `config.json` - Project directories list
- `chat-history.json` - AI chat sessions (last 100)
- `orchestrations.json` - Orchestration definitions
- `run-history.json` - Orchestration run history (last 50 runs)
- `memory-audit-log.json` - Memory brain audit trail (max 5000 entries, 10MB)

#### Documentation
- `docs/*.md` - User documentation (rendered in /docs page)

## 6. SECURITY FEATURES

- **Localhost-only guard** - Restricts to 127.0.0.1/::1
- **Rate limiting** - 3 tiers:
  - Heavy (10/min): AI chat, orchestration, playground
  - Write (60/min): File mutations
  - Read (200/min): Directory listing
- **Path validation** - Prevents directory traversal with base64url encoding
- **Name validation** - Only alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores
- **Blocked files** - Cannot write to `.env*`, `credentials.json`, SSH keys
- **CORS** - Localhost origins only
- **Security headers** - X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy

## 7. WHAT'S MISSING / GAPS FOR AGENT MANAGEMENT

### Organizational & Workflow
1. **No agent versioning** - Can't track agent history or rollback changes
2. **No agent tagging/labels** - Only categories exist; no custom tags
3. **No agent search by content** - Can't find agents by instruction keywords
4. **No batch operations** - Can't bulk-update, copy, or delete agents
5. **No agent dependencies** - Can't model "this agent depends on that agent"

### Team Collaboration
1. **No multi-user support** - Single-user, local-only
2. **No agent sharing/export** - Can't export agent to another system
3. **No agent comments/annotations** - No inline review mechanism
4. **No permissions/access control** - All projects/agents accessible equally

### Monitoring & Analytics
1. **No execution logs** - Playground runs aren't persisted (only orchestration runs)
2. **No performance metrics** - Can't see which agents are slow or fail often
3. **No usage statistics** - Can't see which agents are used most
4. **No error tracking** - Failures aren't aggregated or analyzed

### Quality & Testing
1. **No automated testing framework** - Training is manual corrections only
2. **No test cases per agent** - Can't define input/output pairs to test
3. **No A/B testing** - Can't compare agent versions
4. **No cost tracking** - No API usage metrics (if using Anthropic API)

### Advanced Features
1. **No agent composition** - Can't define "sub-agents" within agents
2. **No conditional logic in orchestration** - Orchestration is strictly sequential DAG
3. **No looping/retries** - No built-in retry mechanism for failed nodes
4. **No human approval workflow** - Can't pause orchestrations for review

### Integrations
1. **No webhook system** - Can't trigger orchestrations from external events
2. **No schedule/cron** - Can't run agents on a schedule
3. **No Git integration** - Agents aren't version-controlled (stored as files but no auto-commit)
4. **No remote storage** - All data is local files

### Developer Experience
1. **No CLI tool** - Management is web-only (SDK exists for calling agents)
2. **No IDE plugin** - VSCode extension exists but likely minimal
3. **No agent templates** - Can't scaffold new agents from templates
4. **No import/export format** - Can't easily migrate agents between systems

### Memory Brain Enhancements
1. **No RAG** - Memory files exist but aren't indexed/searchable with embeddings
2. **No automatic summarization** - Memory files aren't compressed/summarized
3. **No memory tagging** - Can't categorize memory entries
4. **No memory expiry** - Files remain indefinitely

### Data Insights
1. **No agent effectiveness dashboard** - Can't see success rates
2. **No cost attribution** - Can't see which agents/projects cost most
3. **No usage trends** - Can't see adoption patterns over time
4. **No audit compliance** - No formal audit trail for governance

## SUMMARY

Claude Hub is a **powerful local-first agent management dashboard** with strong fundamentals:
- Comprehensive CRUD for agents, rules, commands across scopes
- Real-time orchestration with visual workflow builder
- Memory brain with full audit history
- Training/correction system with baking
- Playground for testing agents

**Key strengths:** Local-only security, file-based simplicity, audit trail, orchestration

**Key gaps:** No versioning, no analytics, no team features, no integrations, no testing framework, no scheduling

**Comparison insight:** If benchmarking against enterprise agent platforms, Claude Hub excels at local development but lacks cloud collaboration, analytics, and operational features.
